title: kate-ui: type, move, undo, and paint every caret
summary: The window inserts typed text and moves every caret. A one-character InsertText can pair a bracket in kate-core. Marked text stays off the buffer until the input method commits it. Paint draws every caret and every selection. This packet does not bind Cmd-O, Cmd-N, or Cmd-W. The keymap module does not import GPUI.

lane.reason: session.rs and paint.rs compile only on macOS. The rust (macos-15) check is the GPUI build evidence. The owner must type on his Mac and confirm an input-method commit. Linux CI runs the keymap tests.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: lib.rs adds mod keys with allow(dead_code) off macOS. The module still compiles on Linux. command_for_binding normalizes modifiers before the lookup. The order is ctrl, alt, shift, cmd. session.rs binds the table and does not copy the match. replace_text_in_range runs command_for_commit and then clears the composition. The marked-text handler stays as it is. After a move or an edit, scroll.first_line comes from reveal_line. scroll_y becomes scroll_y_for_line for that line. A one-character InsertText of an opener is paired by kate-core. The keymap still returns that one character. Tab stays one tab character. snapshot stores caret_marks and selection_spans. paint draws each span and each caret. The primary caret still sets caret_bounds. Cmd-Q and the Quit menu stay. Do not add a dependency. Do not edit the highlight tests. A new Rust file starts with the GPL-3.0-or-later SPDX header. Do not start until PKT-0045 is on main. PKT-0045 owns paint.rs and session.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::binding_table_matches_existing_commands
regression_tests.asserts: Each table row returns that command. cmd-o, cmd-n, cmd-w, and cmd-shift-s return None. An unknown binding returns None.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::commit_inserts_text_and_empty_commit_does_not
regression_tests.asserts: command_for_commit of a\nb is InsertText of that string. An empty string returns None.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::spans_cover_each_line_of_a_selection
regression_tests.asserts: In ab\ncd, a selection from offset 1 through 4 yields a span on line 0 and a span on line 1. A caret yields a mark and no span. Column 1 of e-acute is byte 2.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::reveal_line_puts_the_caret_in_the_window
regression_tests.asserts: A caret inside the window keeps first_line. A caret above moves to that line. A caret below uses caret_line + 1 - visible_rows. Zero rows leaves first_line unchanged.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::modifier_order_is_ctrl_alt_shift_cmd
regression_tests.asserts: cmd-shift-z and shift-cmd-z both return Redo. shift-cmd-left returns Move to the line start with extend. alt-shift-down returns AddCursorBelow.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::scroll_y_matches_the_jumped_line
regression_tests.asserts: scroll_y_for_line of line 4 and height 20 is 80. A height of 0 returns 0. A non-finite height returns 0.
